name: opencode-diane
description: OpenCode plugin: hierarchical, token-efficient memory for any git repository. Convention-free — pre-fills from git diff-structure and project files, no embeddings, no LLM, no commit-message parsing. Includes skill mining.

scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run clean && bun run build
scripts.test: bun tests/store.test.ts && bun tests/search.test.ts && bun tests/ingest.test.ts && bun tests/mining.test.ts && bun tests/sessions.test.ts && bun tests/code-health.test.ts && bun tests/code-map.test.ts && bun tests/session-snapshot.test.ts && bun tests/adaptive.test.ts && bun tests/file-log.test.ts && bun tests/token-savings.test.ts && bun tests/skill-activation.test.ts && bun tests/scaling.test.ts && bun tests/semantic.test.ts && bun tests/ppr.test.ts && bun tests/plugin.test.ts
